authorizationModeSource.note: The official UI maps None to zero for both independent permission modes. These are not inferred from an unnamed byte. Source is linked, not copied into this repository.

scheduleSource.claimablePeriodicFormula: amount_per_period * min(number_of_period, floor((now - cliff_time) / frequency)) when now >= cliff_time; zero before cliff
scheduleSource.note: The cliff itself releases cliff_unlock_amount, which is zero for TRUEQ. The first nonzero release is one complete frequency later.

lockUi.routeEvidence: The official site's Next.js build manifest declares /escrow/[escrow].

limitations: The historical program repository linked from the docs, https://github.com/jup-ag/jup-lock, returned HTTP 404 when checked. The official jup-ag starter repository provides the IDL and mode mappings used here.
This verifies escrow state and transaction behavior against the public interface. It is not an independent byte-for-byte build verification or audit of the Jupiter program.
